change_log.change: K03 restricted to intake cohorts with a full 30-day follow-up window before the extract date (right-censoring). Dataset B months assigned in Australia/Melbourne time, not UTC.

assumptions.text: Extract date is not published; it is taken as the latest date present in each file (A: 2016-11-08, B: 2018-10-17).
assumptions.impact: Ages of open requests and cohort follow-up windows depend on it.

assumptions.text: Dataset A 'days_to_complete' for CLOSED rows equals calendar days with same-day completions recorded as 1. For open rows the field holds the age at extract, not a completion time.
assumptions.impact: A naive median over the whole column mixes completion times with open-case ages (K07).

assumptions.text: Dataset B status 'Closed as Duplicate' is closed; all other non-'Closed' statuses are open.
assumptions.impact: Duplicates close fast and pull B's completion KPIs down; tested in sensitivity.

assumptions.text: Dataset B timestamps are UTC; business dates and months use Australia/Melbourne local time.
assumptions.impact: Requests opened near midnight move day/month.

assumptions.text: Datasets A and B are never combined: different systems, periods, taxonomies and status vocabularies; B is a subset of council requests.

kpis.name: Median days to completion
kpis.question: How long does a typical completed request take?
kpis.blind_spot: Excludes every open request, so the slowest cases are invisible (selection bias / right-censoring).

kpis.name: 90th percentile days to completion
kpis.question: How slow are the slowest completed requests?
kpis.blind_spot: Still closed-only; a backlog of very old open requests is not reflected.

kpis.name: Closure rate within 30 days by intake cohort
kpis.question: Of requests received in a period, what share was finished within 30 days?
kpis.population: all requests received in cohorts with >= 30 days of follow-up before extract
kpis.blind_spot: Says nothing about how late the remainder are.

kpis.name: Open-case ageing
kpis.question: How old are the requests that are still open?
kpis.formula: median and share > 90 days of (extract date - date received)
kpis.blind_spot: Snapshot at one date; cannot show how the backlog evolved.

kpis.name: Open share
kpis.question: What share of requests remains open at extract?
kpis.blind_spot: Recent intake is naturally open; compare like-aged cohorts.

kpis.name: Kaplan-Meier median days to completion
kpis.question: Typical time to completion counting open requests as censored, not excluded.
kpis.formula: time where KM survival S(t) first <= 0.5; open requests censored at age at extract
kpis.blind_spot: Assumes open requests behave like closed requests of the same age (non-informative censoring).

kpis.name: Naive median of days_to_complete (anti-pattern)
kpis.question: What a dashboard shows if it takes the median of the published column.
kpis.blind_spot: Mixes completion times (closed) with ages (open). Technically computable, conceptually wrong. Kept only to demonstrate the error.
